name: localharness
description: A local-first AI harness for the Mac Studio inference server — workflow profiles, MCP orchestration, and live inference telemetry.
author: Adam

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:sandbox && npm run test:calibration && npm run test:activity && node scripts/typed-call-test.mjs && node scripts/trim-test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:smoke

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CaptainLlama uses the microphone for the Live workflow, so you can talk to a model running on your own hardware. Audio is transcribed on this Mac and never leaves your network.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: CaptainLlama uses the camera for the Live workflow, so a vision model on your own hardware can see what you are showing it. Frames go only to your own inference server.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: CaptainLlama reads and edits the code in the workspace folders you choose, which usually live in Documents. It only ever touches paths inside the roots you have added.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: CaptainLlama reads and edits files in the workspace folders you choose. Grant this only if you keep a workspace on the Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: CaptainLlama reads images and documents you attach from Downloads, for the image editing and document workflows.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: CaptainLlama uses Apple Events only to reveal a file in Finder when you ask it to.
